name: hemas-connect
description: Hemas Connect — governed, multi-tenant patient engagement on Firebase.

scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-hemas-connect "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: HEMAS_RUNTIME_MODE=demo HEMAS_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID=workspace_safenet_demo HEMAS_PROVIDER_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_INTEGRATION_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_AUDIT_SINK_MODE=durable HEMAS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false HEMAS_APPROVAL_GATE_REQUIRED=true HEMAS_DIAGNOSIS_ENABLED=false npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --project demo-hemas-connect
scripts.emulators:verify-seed: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-hemas-connect "npm run emulators:seed"
scripts.emulators:verify-audit: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-hemas-connect "node functions/lib/scripts/verify-audit-emulator.js"
scripts.emulators:verify-functions: npm --prefix functions run build && HEMAS_RUNTIME_MODE=demo HEMAS_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID=workspace_safenet_demo HEMAS_PROVIDER_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_INTEGRATION_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_AUDIT_SINK_MODE=durable HEMAS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false HEMAS_APPROVAL_GATE_REQUIRED=true HEMAS_DIAGNOSIS_ENABLED=false npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-hemas-connect "npm run emulators:seed && tsx scripts/verify-functions-emulator.ts"
scripts.emulators:verify-phase5-functions: npm --prefix functions run build && HEMAS_RUNTIME_MODE=demo HEMAS_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID=workspace_safenet_demo HEMAS_PROVIDER_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_INTEGRATION_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_AUDIT_SINK_MODE=durable HEMAS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false HEMAS_APPROVAL_GATE_REQUIRED=true HEMAS_DIAGNOSIS_ENABLED=false npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-hemas-connect "npm run emulators:seed && GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-hemas-connect FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5001 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 tsx scripts/verify-phase5-functions-emulator.ts"
scripts.emulators:verify-compliance-functions: npm --prefix functions run build && HEMAS_RUNTIME_MODE=demo HEMAS_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID=workspace_safenet_demo HEMAS_PROVIDER_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_INTEGRATION_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_AUDIT_SINK_MODE=durable HEMAS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false HEMAS_APPROVAL_GATE_REQUIRED=true HEMAS_DIAGNOSIS_ENABLED=false npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-hemas-connect "npm run emulators:seed && GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-hemas-connect FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5001 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 tsx scripts/verify-compliance-functions-emulator.ts"
scripts.emulators:verify-ingress: npm --prefix functions run build && HEMAS_RUNTIME_MODE=demo HEMAS_PROVIDER_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_INTEGRATION_MODE=synthetic HEMAS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false HEMAS_DIAGNOSIS_ENABLED=false HEMAS_SYNTHETIC_INGRESS_SECRET=PUBLIC-SYNTHETIC-WEBHOOK-FIXTURE-NOT-A-SECRET-2026 HEMAS_RUN_SYNTHETIC_INGRESS_HTTP_TEST=true npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-hemas-connect "node functions/lib/test/ingress-emulator.test.js"
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run emulators:verify-seed && npm run emulators:verify-audit && npm run emulators:verify-functions && npm run emulators:verify-phase5-functions && npm run emulators:verify-compliance-functions && npm run emulators:verify-ingress && npm run build
